reading.body:
Flexential Portland - Hillsboro 3 is a 358,000 square foot facility in Hillsboro, Oregon with 36 megawatts of published critical load UPS capacity. This 36 megawatts of IT load translates, at a conservative assumption of 10 kilowatts per rack for general-purpose colocation, to roughly 3,600 racks, or at the higher density of 40 kilowatts per rack typical of AI training, to roughly 900 racks. The facility holds certifications for financial services compliance (PCI DSS, SOC 1 Type II, SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3), healthcare data (HITRUST), government security frameworks (NIST 800-53), controlled unclassified information (ITAR), and audit standards (SSAE 18).

This campus ranks first by published capacity among the eight data center facilities in Oregon with published megawatt figures, accounting for 23 percent of Oregon's 156.6 megawatts of disclosed IT load. Oregon has 133 mapped data center facilities overall, of which only eight have published power specifications from operator sources. The state's published capacity is concentrated in a small set of disclosed sites.

For AI infrastructure, the relevance of this facility depends on its actual tenant mix and power delivery, both unpublished. The 36 megawatt figure is UPS-backed capacity, which indicates power resilience but does not specify whether the power budget is currently allocated to general colocation, GPU-intensive workloads, or reserved inventory. The security and compliance certifications qualify the site to host regulated workloads but do not indicate which tenants occupy it.
